mapper.sql: g.id,g.name,g.user_access_id,g.master_id, g.sub_ids,g.code,g.schedule_date, g.group_access_ids,g.access_id, g.update_time,g.create_time,a.code as codeName
,a.id as a_id, a.master_id as a_master_id, a.role_type as a_role_type, a.code as a_code
mapper.select: SELECT g.id,g.name,g.update_time,g.code,g.schedule_date,g.group_access_ids,GROUP_CONCAT( u.user_id SEPARATOR ',' ) AS userIds FROM gc_group AS g LEFT JOIN gc_user_access AS ua ON ua.id = g.user_access_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access AS u on JSON_CONTAINS(g.group_access_ids, CONVERT(u.id,CHAR))=1 WHERE ua.master_id = #{masterId} AND ua.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY g.id ORDER BY g.update_time DESC

select g.id as id ,a.user_id as userId from gc_group g LEFT join gc_user_access a ON JSON_CONTAINS(g.group_access_ids,CONVERT ( a.id, CHAR ))= 1 AND g.master_id = a.master_id where g.id in
#{ids}

select distinct from gc_group g left join gc_group_mentor m on m.group_id = g.id left join gc_access a on a.id = g.access_id where m.user_access_id = #{userAccessId} or g.user_access_id=#{userAccessId}
